customer.planHint: Each customer gets their own price. Once saved, the customer sees the plan on their Membership page and pays there. If they paid you offline, activate it directly.
customer.allInclusiveHint: When on, only this price is charged; the base fee and add-on platform price are ignored
customer.saved: Plan saved. The customer can now pay.
customer.offlineHint: Skips Stripe. Credits are issued month by month and each month's credits are only valid that month.
customer.offlineSubmit: Activate {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
customer.adjustReason: Reason (required, not shown to the customer)
customer.invalid: Something's off. Check the fields and try again.
customer.needPlan: Save a plan before activating offline
customer.cancelConfirm: Cancel this customer's plan? Credits already issued are kept.
customer.offlineDone: Activated. Credits will be issued month by month.
customer.activeStripeHint: The customer pays via Stripe. Price changes take effect next billing cycle (once Stripe is connected).
customer.stripeSyncFailed: Saved, but syncing to Stripe failed. Try again shortly.
customer.currencyLocked: This customer pays monthly via Stripe, so the currency can't be changed. Cancel the plan first, then set it up again in the new currency.
customer.freeLive: This customer pays via Stripe, so the plan amount can't be set to 0. Cancel the plan first.
customer.stripeActive: This customer is on Stripe auto-renewal, so activating offline would charge them twice. Cancel the plan first, then activate offline.
